agnostic_oa_w2142239943_endomorphism_geo.boundary_or_failure: Boundary and representation dependency: the construction requires a smooth star-algebra completion, invariant trace, projective module, Hermitian metric, and compatible connection. agnostic_oa_w2142239943_endomorphism_geo.interpretation: Inference: a suitable module can function as an equivalence object that turns its endomorphisms into another presentation of geometry. The dual presentation preserves module-theoretic structure and supports transported trace and derivation behavior, yet it retains representation-level differences that must not be erased by calling the two algebras equivalent.
agnostic_oa_w2142239943_endomorphism_geo.nonparaphrase_operation: To construct a dual geometric presentation, pass from an algebra to endomorphisms of a projective module, transport the trace and induced derivation action through the connection, and audit separately what Morita equivalence preserves and what concrete algebraic form changes.

agnostic_oa_w2142239943_endomorphism_geo.uncertainty: The artifact gives conditions and consequences but defers proofs and does not specify the full range of cases in which the endomorphism algebra has each displayed form.
